begin.policy: Auxiliary branch has no gradient through final waveform. Global head+block and shared-block gradients are reported separately; coefficient calibration uses shared block only. No optimizer updates.

end.policy: Auxiliary branch has no gradient through final waveform. Global head+block and shared-block gradients are reported separately; coefficient calibration uses shared block only. No optimizer updates.

canonical_panel.evaluation_policy: Separate corrected encoder domain; original historical tensors, counts and masks remain unchanged

identity.scope: Existing block9 and head, including block9 LayerNorm learned parameters. First nine blocks and outer normalization parameters/statistics frozen. Auxiliary adapter is training-only and excluded from exported student state. No new deployed layer or automatic promotion.

coefficient-calibration.policy: Teacher waveform alpha1; long-mel output gradient norm initially equals teacher waveform norm across first four training batches. Short branch adds 25% of weighted long-mel norm, without changing long loss coefficients. Same coefficients in all arms including anchored control; not an exact historical continuation.

final_scalar_flags.meaning: Engineering reconstruction screen; not perceptual equivalence or production approval

auxiliary-coefficient-calibration.policy: Auxiliary branch starts at 10% of combined weighted reconstruction norm on shared final-block parameters; first four training batches after fixed ridge calibration.

auxiliary-ridge.scope: Predict first teacher upsampling-block features; not final-waveform cancellation

auxiliary-identity.baseline: Both late and aux start retained joint_spectral, not a selected WN/short candidate
auxiliary-identity.calibration_pool: First four fixed FIT batches only

teacher-reference-warmup.decoder_policy: Singleton original full-source FP32 decoder; unchanged backend
teacher-reference-warmup.encoder_policy: Singleton original FP32 raw mu; scoped cuDNN/TF32 disabled
teacher-reference-warmup.interpretation: Startup stabilization matching the earlier qualified capture protocol; not evidence that sealed targets or historical training were wrong.
